author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: स्वातन्त्र्यसम्भावनाऽपीति भावः । एतावान्गुण इत्याह ॥ न हन्यते हन्यमाने शरीर इति
translation: Neither is he born nor doth he die; and having been once in existence, he is not to be produced again; he is unborn and indestructible, is eternally of the same character; he is a wanderer through bodies; he is not slain, when the body is slain. (20)
